legend: Pache is in a bad mood and ordered Dilon, el Sabrosso, to clean the training area. The area is a straight hallway, which we see as a number line. Dilon starts sweeping at position $$$0$$$ and moves to the right at a constant speed of one unit per second.
Pache watches $$$N$$$ points of the hallway. Point $$$i$$$ is at position $$$x_i$$$. At each point, Pache is angry or calm: at the beginning he is angry if $$$s_i = 1$$$ and calm if $$$s_i = 0$$$.
Dilon starts at position $$$0$$$ and walks to the right. Every time he reaches a point, Pache's mood at that point decides what happens, and then that mood changes:
If Pache is angry, with his powers he instantly teleports Dilon to position $$$0$$$, and Dilon walks to the right again from there. Then Pache becomes calm at that point.
If Pache is calm, Dilon keeps walking and Pache becomes angry at that point.
Dilon finishes cleaning when he reaches position $$$x_N + 1$$$. How many seconds does it take him to get there? Since the answer can be huge, print it modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
It can be shown that Dilon always finishes.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$N$$$, the number of points.
Each of the following $$$N$$$ lines contains two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$s_i$$$: the position of point $$$i$$$ and Pache's initial mood at that point.
output: Print one integer: the time, in seconds, it takes Dilon to reach position $$$x_N + 1$$$, modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
note: Example 1. In the first example, Dilon passes $$$3$$$ at second $$$3$$$ (Pache becomes angry there) and reaches $$$6$$$ at second $$$6$$$, where Pache is angry and sends him back to $$$0$$$. At second $$$9$$$ he reaches $$$3$$$ again, where Pache is now angry, and goes back to $$$0$$$. Then he passes $$$3$$$ (second $$$12$$$), $$$6$$$ (second $$$15$$$) and $$$7$$$ (second $$$16$$$), leaving Pache angry at all three, and at second $$$17$$$ point $$$8$$$ sends him back to $$$0$$$. From there he still has seven more rounds before finally reaching position $$$9$$$ at second $$$57$$$.
Example 2. In the second example Pache starts calm at every point, so Dilon never starts over and reaches position $$$10$$$ at second $$$10$$$.

legend.ai: Pache心情不好，命令Dilon(el Sabrosso)打扫训练场地。该场地是一条直走廊，我们将其视为数轴。Dilon从位置 $$$0$$$ 开始清扫，并以每秒一个单位的恒定速度向右移动。
Pache 观察走廊上的 $$$N$$$ 个点。点 $$$i$$$ 位于位置 $$$x_i$$$。在每个点，Pache 要么愤怒，要么平静：初始时，若 $$$s_i = 1$$$，他就愤怒；若 $$$s_i = 0$$$，他就平静。
Dilon 从位置 $$$0$$$ 出发并向右行走。每当他到达一个点时，Pache 在该点的情绪会决定接下来发生什么，随后该情绪会发生变化：
如果 Pache 生气了，他就会立刻用自己的能力将 Dilon 传送到位置 $$$0$$$，然后 Dilon 从那里再次向右行走。此时 Pache 会恢复平静。
如果 Pache 处于平静状态，Dilon 会继续行走，而 Pache 会在此时变得愤怒。
Dilon 到达位置 $$$x_N + 1$$$ 时完成清扫。他需要多少秒才能到达那里？由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模的结果。
可以证明，Dilon 总会完成。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$N$$$，表示点的数量。
以下 $$$N$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $$$x_i$$$ 和 $$$s_i$$$：分别表示点 $$$i$$$ 的位置以及 Pache 在该点的初始心情。

output.ai: 输出一个整数：Dilon 到达位置 $$$x_N + 1$$$ 所需的时间(单位为秒)，对 $$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模。

note.ai: 例 1。在第一个示例中，Dilon 在第 $$$3$$$ 秒经过 $$$3$$$(Pache 在那里变得愤怒)，并在第 $$$6$$$ 秒到达 $$$6$$$，此时 Pache 正在生气，于是把他送回 $$$0$$$。在第 $$$9$$$ 秒，他再次到达 $$$3$$$，此时 Pache 也在生气，于是他返回 $$$0$$$。接着，他经过 $$$3$$$(第 $$$12$$$ 秒)、$$$6$$$(第 $$$15$$$ 秒)和 $$$7$$$(第 $$$16$$$ 秒)，这三处都让 Pache 保持愤怒。到了第 $$$17$$$ 秒，$$$8$$$ 又把他送回 $$$0$$$。从那里开始，他还要再经过七轮，最终在第 $$$57$$$ 秒到达位置 $$$9$$$。
示例 2。在第二个示例中，Pache 在每个点都以平静状态开始，因此 Dilon 从未重新开始，并在第 $$$10$$$ 秒到达位置 $$$10$$$。
